browser: Microsoft Edge / Chromium, real rendered DOM and hit-tested mouse
evidenceBoundary: XHR responses, challenge grants, and five-second polling ticks are controlled client fixtures. These tests do not claim backend security or iPad Safari compatibility.

coverage.old: HTTP writes blocked before the first successful state sync
coverage.current: Initial sync hold/failure blocks public and protected writes, preserves draft, then permits fresh verification

coverage.old: Explicit file mode permits local-only actions without requests
coverage.current: Actual source file:// page publicly completes/persists a reminder without any XHR; packaged export is separately checked

coverage.old: Only one outstanding polling GET, resumes after completion or timeout
coverage.current: Actual polling callback and XHR timeout preserve single-flight behavior

coverage.old: Delayed older GET cannot roll back a successful POST
coverage.current: Public reminder completion followed by old GET cannot roll back revision, memory, or storage

coverage.old: Reward price sync refreshes confirmation and requires a second click
coverage.current: Pending redemption approval refreshes price, preserves note, requires review and new per-operation verification before spending

coverage.old: Timeout/conflict/retry reuses action ID and books once
coverage.current: Lost committed award response keeps ID; conflict or polling reconciliation must reveal exactly one award; next award gets a new ID and verification

coverage.old: Uncommitted conflict retry keeps ID while advancing revision
coverage.current: Concurrent public change preserves award draft/ID and requires a fresh challenge tied to the new revision

coverage.old: New v0.3 regression for a connection lost after startup
coverage.current: Timeout, 503, and malformed snapshots visibly disconnect and block writes without losing the draft; a valid snapshot restores usability
